task_description: Three agents collaborate to gather and synthesize research about renewable energy sources from various online publications and databases, reconcile any conflicting information, and produce a comprehensive report with clear source attribution.
expected_outcome: If everything works correctly, agents will gather accurate and complete information, reconcile conflicts, and create a cohesive report with correct source attributions.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for searching and retrieving information from multiple online sources related to renewable energy.
This agent synthesizes the gathered data, checks for conflicts, and resolves them by verifying with additional sources.
This agent compiles the final report, ensuring all sources are properly attributed and the report is well-structured.
